Context: (e) For purchase of plot and construction of house.-

- (ii) Double Storeyed House: 30% of advance for cost of plot will be disbursed on executing the agreement. The balance amount will be disbursed in two equal instalments, the first on executing the mortgage deed and the second on construction reaching plinth level. - Rule 8 (v).
9. Interest.(1) The advances carry simple interest from the date of payment of the first instalment and is calculated on the balance outstanding on the last day of each month.
